newsitem.title: USA: Thompson PBE to repurchase shares. [CORRECTED 23:55 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Thompson PBE to repurchase shares. [CORRECTED 23:55 GMT]

text.p: Thompson PBE Inc said its board approved the repurchase of up to 500,000 shares of its common stock.

The company also said its chairman and chief executive officer, D. Hunt Ramsbottom, will leave the company on January 1 "to devote his efforts to other business interests." Mortimer Kline, Thompson PBE president, was named to the additional positions of chairman and chief executive officer.

In addition, Thompson said it lost its exclusive agreement to distribute Akzo Nobel NV paint line in parts of southern California and Arizona. (Corrects to make clear Thompson lost the exclusive agreement, not Akzo Nobel).
The exclusive contract with Akzo expires on December 31, after which Thompson will be able to distribute Akzo paints on a non-exclusive bais for another four months.
It said its sales of the Akzo paint line amounts to three to four percent of its total revenues and it is evaluating the alternatives to the loss of that contract.
While Thompson said it cannot forecast the impact of the loss of that contract, it expects it "will have at least a modest adverse effect on its results."
